Title: Not Found Page
Summary: Not Found (404) page with proper PageTitle and MainLayout.
Content:
## NotFound.razor **Path:** `Components/Pages/NotFound.razor` **Type:** Routable page component ### Route ```razor @page "/not-found" ``` ### Layout ```razor @layout MainLayout ``` Explicitly uses `MainLayout` (same as the default, but explicit for clarity). ### Content ```razor Not Found

Not Found

Sorry, the content you are looking for does not exist.

``` ### Routing Configured in `Program.cs` as the status code page for 404 responses: ```csharp app.UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute("/not-found", createScopeForStatusCodePages: true); ``` This means: - Server-side 404s (e.g., missing static files, unmatched API routes) are re-executed to this page. - Client-side 404s (unmatched Blazor routes) are handled by `Routes.razor`'s `NotFoundPage` attribute, which also renders this component. ### Notes - `createScopeForStatusCodePages: true` ensures a DI scope is created when re-executing. - The `` component updates the browser tab title for accessibility and SEO. - Previously missing ``; now added for consistency.
